plugins.name: cache-countdown
plugins.description: Counts down to the prompt cache going cold, warns before it does, and when it has, offers to send with full context or compress the session first.

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: A live sidebar of the session's vitals: prompt cache, context, spend and today's usage, edited files to open in Zed, background tasks, and a pixel claw that reacts to it all.
